_note: Affinity lives on the ATTACKING element and names the defender's element (§2: AFFINITY[ability.element][defender.element], 0.5 | 1.0 | 1.5 | 2.0). Unlisted matchups are 1.0. Declaring matchups per element means a mod adding one writes its own row instead of patching a global matrix nobody owns.

defs.name: Holy
defs._note: The only 2.0 in the base game. Holy is the anti-dark specialist and pays for it by being the weakest generalist.
